scripts.lint: turbo run lint --concurrency=1 && eslint eslint.config.js vitest.config.js scripts tests apps/web/vite.config.js apps/web/eslint.web.js scripts/privacy-check
scripts.test: turbo run test --concurrency=1 && vitest run && node tests/prototype/physics.mjs && pnpm run test:ui
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-little-galaxy "pnpm exec vitest run --config tests/rules/vitest.config.js"
scripts.test:drills: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-little-galaxy "pnpm --filter @little-galaxy/stand exec tsx ../../scripts/drills.ts"
scripts.test:load: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-little-galaxy "pnpm --filter @little-galaxy/stand exec tsx ../../scripts/load-test.ts"
